exposure: Hospital frequency of labor after cesarean (LAC)
outcome: Vaginal birth after cesarean (VBAC) success rate
cohort: The study included 43,331 women in California who underwent labor after cesarean (LAC) between 2007 and 2010.
finding: High hospital frequency of LAC was not associated with increased VBAC success rates, and was associated with higher odds of maternal infection and postpartum hemorrhage in certain hospital volume categories.
